lesson.subtitle: Lesson 8 -- The Hotel Gym
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 8 -- The Hotel Gym

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Park Hotel gym. I am Mike, your trainer. I am here every morning, from six to ten. Do you want a plan for your trip? Ask me! Today the spinning class is at six in the evening. And please, take a towel. They are next to the door.

Hi! I'm Kate. I am a guest here, too. I train every morning at six. I like the treadmill, and I love yoga. I don't like weights. On a trip, I don't train for one hour. I train for thirty minutes, and that is OK!

extra_audio.text: It is six in the morning. Bruna goes to the hotel gym. Her bag is in the locker. She runs on the treadmill. Mike, the trainer, says: see you on Wednesday!

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: I train every morning. I like the treadmill.
lesson.grammar_point: present simple with I and you (I train / I don't / Do you...?)
